content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() safe_text = html.escape(name, quote=True) # Only allow http/https absolute URLs; otherwise neutralize the link target. allowed = False try: # Reject control characters / whitespace within the URL if url and not any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 or c.isspace() for c in url): parts = urlsplit(url) if parts.scheme.lower() in ("http", "https") and parts.netloc: allowed = True except ValueError: allowed = False href = html.escape(url, quote=True) if allowed else "#" if allowed: return f'{safe_text}' return f'{safe_text}'
